consumer_guidance.thought_core: Treat this file as a discovery and interpretation map only. It can decide whether a Self Mirror result is useful feedback, but it must not dispatch correction, close an issue, claim release readiness, or run another route by itself.
consumer_guidance.diagnostics: Read self_mirror_metric_summary.json as the authority packet and store redacted status/evidence refs only.
consumer_guidance.human_operator: Use the projection-visual starter profile first; do not share raw frames or screenshots by default.
